nodes.title: Placeholder section camber 1.6 %
nodes.text: Until B2 supplies the MH 45 coordinates, CAD and these claims use a NACA 00xx thickness at params wing.t_c with a reflexed cubic camber line, maximum camber 1.6 % chord, zero crossing at 80 % chord
nodes.basis: EST for an MH 45-class reflexed section; replaced by subsystems/wing/mh45.dat (CR-A5-02)

nodes.title: Minimum foam over the spar
nodes.text: Hot-wired XPS must keep at least 2 mm of foam between the spar tube and the skin on both surfaces
nodes.basis: A5 modelling standard: thinner foam tears when the slot is cut and the tube bonded; G2 confirms on a test core

nodes.title: Minimum elevon end gap
nodes.text: Each elevon panel end stays at least 10 mm from the pod side, the fin face and the wing tip
nodes.basis: A5 modelling standard: room for tape, a horn and +/-25 deg travel without rubbing; D6 confirms

nodes.title: Foam-board layer thickness
nodes.text: One layer of the fin foam board is 4.8 mm (3/16 in)
nodes.basis: params fins.material text; measure a sheet

nodes.title: Allocation split used for the layout CG
nodes.text: Within each allocation: wing = spar 102 g + core/tape/elevons rest; fins = 2 x 111 fin (incl. clips, epoxy) + 2 x 43 tube + 4 x 18 mount + 2 x 15 saddle; propulsion = 4 x 87.5 motor+ESC at the motor + 4 x 20 prop; power = 550 pack + rest behind it; pod, avionics in the pod; mechanisms at the servo pockets; harness on the skin at x 0.01 m; growth reserve not placed
nodes.basis: params.json#mass.allocation_g notes; the skeleton (redesign/fusion/skeleton) uses the same split

nodes.title: Elevon hinge line
nodes.equation: x_h = c (1 - f) ; z_h = upper surface at x_h/c ; t_h = section thickness at the hinge

nodes.title: Foam cover over the spar
nodes.equation: cover_up = z_upper(x_s) - (z_s + r) ; cover_lo = (z_s - r) - z_lower(x_s) ; z_camber = (z_upper + z_lower)/2 ; cover_on_camber = (t(x_s) - 2r)/2

nodes.title: Elevon end gaps
nodes.equation: pod = y_in0 - w_pod/2 ; fin_in = (y_fin - t_fin/2) - y_in1 ; fin_out = y_out0 - (y_fin + t_fin/2) ; tip = b/2 - y_out1 ; t_fin = layers t_board

nodes.title: Layout CG: allocations at the datum stations
nodes.equation: x_cg = sum(m_i x_i) / sum(m_i), z likewise; pack x for x_target = x_pack + M (x_target - x_cg) / m_pack ; upper-pair hover share = (z_m + z_cg) / (2 z_m)

nodes.title: Elevon hinge line station
nodes.how: Datum DP-HINGE in Fusion (00 Datums); on the core, measure from the LE to the hinge cut.

nodes.title: Hinge height (upper skin at the hinge)
nodes.how: Re-run after B2 supplies the MH 45 .dat; on the core, height of the upper skin at the hinge cut above the chord line.

nodes.title: Foam over the spar, thinner side
nodes.how: With the spar on the chord line (wing.spar.z_m = 0) the tube breaks the lower skin; move it to the camber line (CR-A5-01). Check on the first cut core with a depth gauge on both surfaces.

nodes.title: Spar height on the local camber line
nodes.how: Recommended wing.spar.z_m; recompute with the real MH 45 coordinates.

nodes.title: Foam over the spar if centred on the camber line
nodes.how: Same core check after the spar is moved.

nodes.title: Smallest elevon end gap
nodes.how: check.py --skeleton (bounding boxes); on the aircraft, feeler gauge at each panel end at +/-25 deg.

nodes.title: Forward CG limit (params cg.x_range_m[0])
nodes.how: B3 sets the range from AVL (CR-A1-06).

nodes.title: Layout CG x (allocations at the datum stations)
nodes.how: Cross-check with the CAD roll-up (python -I redesign/fusion/check.py --skeleton, TOTAL line). A3 replaces the allocations with part masses (MASS-CG.md); H1 balances the built aircraft on two knife edges.

nodes.title: Pack centre needed for the CG target
nodes.how: D2/A3: compare with the pod length; the pod as sized ends at x = 0.18 m.

nodes.title: Upper CG z limit (params cg.z_range_m[1])
Layout CG z (allocations at the datum stations)
nodes.how: H1: hang the aircraft from two points to find z; A3 tracks in MASS-CG.md.

nodes.title: Hover thrust share of the upper motor pair
nodes.how: B3/E1: differential thrust needed to trim hover pitch; read from the hover log (motor outputs).

nodes.title: Spar cover on the first cut core
nodes.procedure: Cut a 100 mm core section, cut the slot, depth-gauge foam above and below the slot (G2).

nodes.title: CG balance of the built aircraft
nodes.procedure: Pack in, props on; two knife edges under the wing at the fin roots; mark x (H1).
